title: VCR technique record
description: One visual technique under catalog/techniques/<id>.json: what it expresses, where its craft lives, and which catalogue tools can execute it (ADR 0010). Links only. Evidence class, tool validation and machine readiness are derived at read time and never stored here.

summary.description: What it looks like and what it expresses. No thresholds: those belong to the pillar rule.

craft.description: Pointers into the pillars that own the craft. Pillars never point back.

pillar.description: Directory under references/, e.g. fx or motion-director.

section.description: Knowledge base section number as `vcr refs section` takes it: 5.1, 9c.

rules.description: Rule IDs of that pillar; may be empty.

routes.description: Ways to execute the technique with catalogue tools. May be empty: a technique with no route is a visible gap. Alternatives are separate routes.

does.description: What the step contributes. Not a command or recipe: those live in the toolkit guide.

capability.description: From catalog/capabilities/vocabulary.json; every tool in the step must list it.

tools.description: Tools used together in this step, not alternatives.

facet.description: A facet id carried by every tool in the step.

example.description: An examples/<id> fixture that exercises this whole route and lists it back in its `techniques`.
